scope: Exposed public VideoXum mechanism diagnostic; frozen 12-point VPB observations, TRAIN-only readout, exact 85% budget
hypothesis: Adjacent VPB change contains transferable event-state information beyond cubic position; static and dynamic readouts should improve source-macro F on DEV.
practical_gate: At least one content arm delta >=0.005 with source bootstrap 95% lower bound >0 before spending on denser observation or full training.
limitations: DEV sources were previously exposed in R24/R26 and are not independent confirmation.
VideoXum summary labels differ from AIC high-light semantics and contain unknown annotation policy.
VPB features are frozen and only 12 observations are available; negative result does not reject audio or richer event structure.
No official test labels, protected sources, artificial labels, or upload are used.
Linear readout is a mechanism probe, not a deployable competition model.
